desc: Implement the solution class with the optimized O(N) logic using prefix sums and frequency maps for digits 3, 7, 9, and direct counting for 1, 2, 5.
Ensure correct handling of leading zeros and the "non-zero last digit" constraint.
Verify edge cases (e.g., string with all zeros, single digit strings) and ensure the code is enclosed in the correct delimiters and format.
